metadata.dcterms:title: Fiber Functors of Equivariantizations of Finite Tensor Categories
metadata.dcterms:creator: CÉSAR GALINDO, CLAUDIA GALLEGO
MORALES, YIBY
metadata.dcterms:abstract: Let G be a finite group acting on a finite tensor category C. We classify fiber functors on the equivariantization CG in terms of equivariant exact module categories over C, indexed by subgroups of G. The data are a subgroup H ⊆G and an H-equivariant C-module category M whose underlying C-module category is indecomposable, exact, and semisimple; they give a fiber functor precisely when H acts transitively on the simple objects of M and the stabilizer cocycle of one, hence every, simple object is non-degenerate. Through Tannaka–Krein reconstruction this describes realizations of CG as the representation category of a finite-dimensional Hopf algebra, with no semisimplicity hypothesis on C. As applications, for odd primes p we determine the fiber functors on Rep(Hp), where Hp denotes Nikshych’s semisimple Hopf algebra of dimension 4p2 [Nik08]: there is one equivalence class if p ≡3 (mod 4) and two if p ≡1 (mod 4). We also use the classification for gaugings to determine which non-pointed entries in the small-dimensional list of [GN25] are representation categories of semisimple factorizable Hopf algebras.
